title: Roadmap dependency drift detection and cutover runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Cross-team roadmap items frequently drift from initial sequencing (API contracts, infra capacity, designs), causing last-minute cutover firefights and missed SLAs. Goal: Build a lightweight dependency drift detection pipeline + operational cutover runbook that provides automatic alerts for drift, an ownership ledger snapshot per cutover window, and an actionable rollback/canary plan surfaced in the Console. This reduces manual orchestration and shortens mean time to safe cutover for features that span Eng/Design/Security/Infra.
acceptance_criteria: Automated drift detector runs nightly and flags inconsistencies between declared dependency metadata (owner, expected cutover date, compatibility contract) and observed signals (PR status, infra capacity forecast, security gate status)
Console shows a dependency snapshot card for each cutover window with ownership, health signals, and risk score
On-assign playbook created: for any flagged dependency with risk_score >= 0.6 an auto-created TODO is assigned to the dependency owner with prescriptive remediation steps
Cutover runbook document published with step-by-step canary, rollback, and stakeholder-notification templates and linked to the Console card
Three cross-team dry-runs completed for upcoming releases with measured reduction in manual escalations versus baseline (target: 60% fewer ad-hoc messages within 48h of cutover)
tasks: Design dependency drift data model (fields: owner, declared_cutover, contract_sha, expected_capacity, security_gate_id, tags)
Instrument drift signals: PR merge status, pipeline health, infra capacity forecast, security gate pass/fail, and design finalization flag
Implement nightly drift job (ETL) and compute risk_score using weighted heuristics (staleness, failing gates, capacity shortfall)
Create Console card UI: snapshot view, risk timeline, attachable runbook, and quick-assign action
Draft cutover runbook templates: pre-cutover checklist, canary rollout steps, rollback checklist, postmortem anchors
Coordinate dry-run calendar with Eng, Design, Infra, Security and schedule two-week lead time for rehearsals
Add alerting rules and playbook to PagerDuty and Slack channel triage flow
Ship documentation and hold cross-team review session; incorporate feedback and finalize
